root_cause.text: The `panel-simple` entry for the DataImage `SCF0700C48GGU18` panel was added without initializing `struct panel_desc.connector_type`, so `devm_drm_panel_bridge_add()` in the DRM panel bridge code rejected the panel due to an invalid/missing connector type and the panel could not be registered.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `+	.connector_type = DRM_MODE_CONNECTOR_DPI,` to `dataimage_scf0700c48ggu18` in `drivers/gpu/drm/panel/panel-simple.c`, and the CVE/commit message states that `devm_drm_panel_bridge_add()` “requires connector type to be set” and warns at `drivers/gpu/drm/bridge/panel.c:379` when no valid connector type is present.

intent_record.intent_summary: Explicitly mark the panel as a DPI connector type so it is correctly classified by the DRM subsystem.
intent_record.what: A new field assignment, `.connector_type = DRM_MODE_CONNECTOR_DPI,`, was added to the `dataimage_scf0700c48ggu18` panel descriptor struct initializer.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the panel description now explicitly advertises the panel as a DPI connector type, which affects how the display subsystem classifies and exposes this panel to DRM clients and connector handling logic.

grouping_result.intent: Explicitly mark the panel as a DPI connector type so it is correctly classified by the DRM subsystem.

relevance_review.reason: The root cause is the missing initialization of panel_desc.connector_type for the SCF0700C48GGU18 panel, which caused DRM panel bridge registration to fail. This change explicitly sets the panel as a DPI connector type, directly fixing that missing/invalid connector type.

candidates.rationale: This panel descriptor section lacks any initialization of .connector_type before the fix; the missing field leaves the connector type unset, causing drm_panel_bridge_add() to reject the panel.

The shown pre-fix statement is part of that descriptor block and identifies the vulnerable location where the new panel entry was added without setting connector_type, causing devm_drm_panel_bridge_add() to reject the panel.
